verses.greek: Συνίστημι δὲ ὑμῖν Φοίβην τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν, οὖσαν καὶ διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἐν Κεγχρεαῖς,
verses.literal: I commend now to you Phoebe the sister of us being also a servant of the church the in Cenchrea
verses.dgt: Now I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is also a servant of the church in Cenchreae,

verses.greek: ἵνα αὐτὴν προσδέξησθε ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι, καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: that her you may receive in the Lord worthily the of the saints and you may assist her in whatever maybe of you she may need matter Also for she a patroness of many has been and of me myself.
verses.dgt: so that you may receive her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints and stand by her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also became a patron of many, including me.

verses.greek: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν τοὺς συνεργούς μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
verses.literal: do greet Prisca and Aquila the fellow workers of mine in Christ Jesus —
verses.dgt: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

verses.greek: οἵτινες ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου τὸν ἑαυτῶν τράχηλον ὑπέθηκαν, οἷς οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος εὐχαριστῶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν,
verses.literal: who for the life of mine for it their own neck laid down whom not I myself only thank but also all the churches of the Gentiles —
verses.dgt: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks but also all the churches of the Gentiles,

verses.greek: καὶ τὴν κατʼ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίαν. ἀσπάσασθε Ἐπαίνετον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου, ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀσίας εἰς Χριστόν.
verses.literal: and the at house of them church. do greet Epenetus the beloved of mine who is a firstfruit the of Asia for Christ.
verses.dgt: and greet the church in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the firstfruits of Asia for Christ.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Μαριάμ, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: do greet Mary who much toiled for you.
verses.dgt: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνίαν τοὺς συγγενεῖς μου καὶ συναιχμαλώτους μου, οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις, οἳ καὶ πρὸ ἐμοῦ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ.
verses.literal: do greet Andronicus and Junia the kinsmen of mine and fellow prisoners with me who are of note among the apostles who also before me were in Christ.
verses.dgt: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.literal: do greet Ampliatus the beloved of mine in the Lord.
verses.dgt: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Οὐρβανὸν τὸν συνεργὸν ἡμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ Στάχυν τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου.
verses.literal: do greet Urbanus the fellow worker of us in Christ and Stachys the beloved of mine.
verses.dgt: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀπελλῆν τὸν δόκιμον ἐν Χριστῷ. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἀριστοβούλου.
verses.literal: do greet Apelles the approved in Christ. do greet those of the household of Aristobulus.
verses.dgt: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those from the household of Aristobulus.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Ἡρῳδίωνα τὸν συγγενῆ μου. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ναρκίσσου τοὺς ὄντας ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.literal: do greet Herodion the kinsman of mine. do greet those of the household of Narcissus who are being in the Lord.
verses.dgt: Greet Herodion, my relative. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Τρύφαιναν καὶ Τρυφῶσαν τὰς κοπιώσας ἐν κυρίῳ. ἀσπάσασθε Περσίδα τὴν ἀγαπητήν, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.literal: do greet Tryphena and Tryphosa those toiling in the Lord. do greet Persis the beloved who much toiled in the Lord.
verses.dgt: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, women who work hard in the Lord. Greet Persis the beloved, who worked very hard in the Lord.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Ῥοῦφον τὸν ἐκλεκτὸν ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμοῦ.
verses.literal: do greet Rufus the chosen in the Lord and the mother of him and of me.
verses.dgt: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀσύγκριτον, Φλέγοντα, Ἑρμῆν, Πατροβᾶν, Ἑρμᾶν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς ἀδελφούς.
verses.literal: do greet Asyncritus Phlegon Hermes Patrobas Hermas and the with them brothers.
verses.dgt: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers and sisters with them.

verses.greek: ἀσπάσασθε Φιλόλογον καὶ Ἰουλίαν, Νηρέα καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ὀλυμπᾶν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς πάντας ἁγίους.
verses.literal: do greet Philologus and Julia Nereus and the sister of him and Olympas and the with them all saints.
verses.dgt: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.

verses.greek: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ. Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι πᾶσαι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: do greet one another with a kiss holy. Greet you the churches all the of Christ.
verses.dgt: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.

verses.greek: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, σκοπεῖν τοὺς τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε ποιοῦντας, καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπʼ αὐτῶν·
verses.literal: I exhort now you brothers to watch out for those the divisions and the obstacles contrary to the teaching that you yourselves have learned causing and do turn away from them.
verses.dgt: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who create divisions and stumbling blocks contrary to the teaching that you learned, and turn away from them.

verses.greek: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν Χριστῷ οὐ δουλεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τῇ ἑαυτῶν κοιλίᾳ, καὶ διὰ τῆς χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐλογίας ἐξαπατῶσι τὰς καρδίας τῶν ἀκάκων.
verses.literal: the For such the Lord of us Christ not serve but the their own belly and through the smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
verses.dgt: For such people do not serve our Lord Christ but their own belly, and through smooth speech and flattery they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.

verses.greek: ἡ γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπακοὴ εἰς πάντας ἀφίκετο· ἐφʼ ὑμῖν οὖν χαίρω, θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς σοφοὺς εἶναι εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἀκεραίους δὲ εἰς τὸ κακόν.
verses.literal: The for of you obedience to all has reached Over you therefore I rejoice. I wish however you wise to be to the good innocent however to the evil.
verses.dgt: For your obedience has reached everyone; therefore I rejoice over you, but I want you to be wise concerning good and innocent concerning evil.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης συντρίψει τὸν Σατανᾶν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν ἐν τάχει. ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: The now God the of peace will crush the Satan under the feet of you with speed. The grace of the Lord of us Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.dgt: And the God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

verses.greek: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Τιμόθεος ὁ συνεργός μου, καὶ Λούκιος καὶ Ἰάσων καὶ Σωσίπατρος οἱ συγγενεῖς μου.
verses.literal: Greets you Timothy the fellow worker of mine also Lucius and Jason and Sosipater the kinsmen of mine.
verses.dgt: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my relatives.

verses.greek: ἀσπάζομαι ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ Τέρτιος ὁ γράψας τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ἐν κυρίῳ.
verses.literal: Greet you I myself Tertius the one having written down this letter in the Lord.
verses.dgt: I, Tertius, the one who wrote the letter, greet you in the Lord.

verses.greek: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Γάϊος ὁ ξένος μου καὶ ὅλης τῆς ἐκκλησίας. ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἔραστος ὁ οἰκονόμος τῆς πόλεως καὶ Κούαρτος ὁ ἀδελφός.
verses.literal: Greets you Gaius the host of mine and of all the church. Greets you Erastus the steward of the city and Quartus the brother.
verses.dgt: Gaius, host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, greets you, and Quartus the brother.

verses.greek: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν. Ἀμήν.
verses.literal: the grace of the Lord of us Jesus Christ with all of you. Amen.
verses.dgt: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.
